information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkwOTEzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d53eea84ed18d3c36814d019e06e8282e2f48838/ALChampionship2026-01.png) We are excited to welcome you to Alabama Championship 2026, the second state championship for Alabama! This competition is open to everyone, but only Alabama residents are eligible for Alabama Champion titles - see the [Alabama Champion Eligibility](#76362-alabama-champion-eligibility) tab for more info. ![southeastcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDI1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9de1c0ebe62c6dc55566d579b73b3e7217ed5110/SOUTHEAST_5.png) This competition is organized in part by Alabama Crimson Cubing, the University of Alabama's cubing club, and is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](#76360-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
